16: ## 3. Name format validation

21: ## 4. `enabled: false` flag

24: - [ ] 4.2 Update `parseTriviaGames` to accept optional `enabled`; default to `true` when absent; drop entry with warning when `enabled` is present but non-boolean.

28: ## 5. Games-registry helper module
29: 
30: - [ ] 5.1 Create `src/plugins/trivia/gameName.ts` — exposes `isValidName(s): boolean`. (The format check is encoded in the parser; this helper is for runtime tool validation when a tool receives a `game` arg.)

32: - [ ] 5.3 Unit tests for `gamesRegistry.ts` — happy paths, unknown-game, disabled-game, channel-inference (configured / unconfigured / disabled).

34: ## 6. Per-game data accessor

36: - [ ] 6.1 Add `forGame(name: string)` to `TriviaDataLayer` and `createSdkDataLayer` in `src/plugins/trivia/data.ts`. Returns scoped accessors: `loadQuestions`, `saveQuestion`, `updateQuestion`, `loadAnswers`, `saveAnswer`, `loadCheats`, `saveCheat` (composes with the global users update), `loadSeasonsState`, `saveSeasonsState`, `getCurrentSeasonSlug`. All I/O paths resolve to `data/plugins/trivia/games/<name>/<file>.json`.
37: - [ ] 6.2 Implement **lazy season-bootstrap** inside `forGame(name).loadSeasonsState()`: when `trivia.seasons.enabled` is `true` and `games/<name>/seasons.json` is missing, seed a starter season (slug `season-YYYY-MM`, `startedAt: now`, `expectedEndAt: end-of-current-UTC-month`, `categories: copy of global categories.json`) before returning.
38: - [ ] 6.3 Keep top-level `loadCategories`/`saveCategories`/`loadUsers`/`saveUser` as global (unchanged).
39: - [ ] 6.4 Unit tests for `forGame` — writes go to the correct directory; reads see only that game's data; cross-game writes don't contaminate; lazy season-bootstrap fires on first `loadSeasonsState`.

41: ## 7. Data-move via migration 019 (merged)
42: 
43: - [x] 7.1 Extend the pre-existing `019-trivia-games-migration` to also move legacy flat data into a per-game directory. The data-move step runs AFTER the cron-jobs → `config.trivia.games[]` step so newly-created `legacy-<channel>` entries are eligible inheritance targets.
44: - [x] 7.2 Implement the inheritance order in the migration:
45:   - If flat files are absent OR per-game files already exist under `games/<fallback>/`, the data-move step is a no-op.
46:   - Otherwise the target is the first newly-created `legacy-<channel>` from step 1, else the first pre-existing `config.trivia.games[]` entry, else a fallback `initialgame` entry (`channel: "C000000000"`, `questionCron: "0 0 * * 0"`, `revealCron: "0 0 * * 0"`, `timezone: "UTC"`, `enabled: false`).
47: - [x] 7.3 Extend `019-trivia-games-migration.test.ts` with cases: fresh deployment writes nothing; flat data + dispatcher schedule lands in `legacy-<channel>`; flat data + pre-existing config game lands in first existing entry; flat data with no schedule + no config game creates the fallback `initialgame`; multi-channel dispatcher lands data in the first new entry; idempotency on the data-move step; dispatcher-only with no flat data writes no per-game files.
48: - [x] 7.4 No new migration registration needed — 019 is already in the runner.

50: ## 8. `list_games` tool

93: ## 13. `triviaCheckInstruction` update
94: 
95: - [ ] 13.1 Update `src/plugins/trivia/triviaCheckInstruction.ts` so the rendered instruction:
96:   - Mentions `list_games` and the per-game scoping model.
97:   - Directs Claude that in reactive sessions, the game is resolved from the channel (via `resolveGameFromChannel` semantically — Claude checks `config.trivia.games[]` whose `channel` matches the session's channel).
98:   - States that the `game` slug is internal — Claude SHALL NOT surface it to end-users.
99:   - When `seasons.enabled` is `true`, references `upsert_season(game, ...)`, `delete_season(game, slug)`, `list_seasons(game)`, `add_categories({ game, target: "<slug>" })`, `remove_categories({ game, target: "<slug>" })`, and the independence-of-timelines rule.
100: - [ ] 13.2 Update the triviaCheck test (if any) to assert the new content; verify the resolved instruction does NOT mention games when `seasons.enabled` is false in the per-section toggles.

102: ## 14. Plugin index wiring
103: 
104: - [ ] 14.1 In `src/plugins/trivia/index.ts`:
105:   - Register `list_games`.
106:   - Remove the plugin-load seasons bootstrap (now lazy per-game via `data.forGame(name)`).
107:   - Verify every per-game tool's `registerTool` call uses the updated label template (with `{game}`).
108:   - When `trivia.seasons.enabled`, register the four season tools as before but with updated descriptions/labels.
109: - [ ] 14.2 Verify `buildGameSpecs(games, seasonsEnabled)` is invoked once per plugin load and that `sdk.reconcileCronJobs("trivia", specs)` receives a spec list whose disabled games are filtered out.

111: ## 15. Type-check, lint, tests
112: 
113: - [ ] 15.1 Run `npx tsc` and resolve every type error. Focus on call sites where `game` was forgotten.
114: - [ ] 15.2 Run `npx oxlint src/plugins/trivia/ src/migrations/`. Fix new lints.
115: - [ ] 15.3 Run `npm test` and ensure every trivia test file passes. Add any missed coverage (cross-game isolation, disabled-game refusal, lazy season-bootstrap, migration 019 data-move idempotency).
116: 
117: ## 16. Operator-facing release notes
118: 
119: - [ ] 16.1 Write a short release note summarizing:
120:   - Migration 019 runs automatically. Single-channel deployments with an existing dispatcher schedule end up with a `legacy-<channel>` entry containing both the schedule (from step 1) and the legacy data (from step 2's inheritance).
121:   - Deployments with legacy flat data but no schedule get a fallback `initialgame` entry with placeholder crons + `enabled: false`. To resume scheduled trivia for the migrated game, edit `config.trivia.games[]`: replace `channel` with the real Slack channel ID, replace `questionCron` / `revealCron` / `timezone`, and set `enabled: true`.
122:   - Multi-channel deployments end up with one `legacy-<channel>` per dispatcher pair and all legacy data concentrated in the first entry; redistribute by moving files between `data/plugins/trivia/games/<name>/` directories if needed.
123:   - Admins create / disable additional games by editing `config.trivia.games[]` directly. The plugin reconciles cron jobs automatically.
124:   - Members can call `list_games` to introspect available games.
125:   - In reactive sessions (DM / mention), Claude uses channel→game inference to resolve which game's data to read/write; configured channels resolve transparently; unconfigured channels refuse with a clear error.
